title: Activation steering technique reduces sycophancy and hallucination in medical LLM responses
summary: Researchers developed gated activation steering to reduce sycophancy and hallucination in medical LLM responses. The inference-time technique applies steering vectors to causally verified attention heads, with behavior-specific gates controlling when intervention activates. Testing showed a 4-billio
takeaways: Gated activation steering: inference-time intervention for clinical LLMs
Unsteered model changed answer under pressure in 570 of 600 test cases
Steered model improved robustness: maintained position in 551 of 570 cases
Steered 4B-parameter model achieved robustness of 100B+ parameter models
Tested on 600 pressure trajectories; 15,900 total model-response runs

title: New machine-learning framework improves computational protein design beyond natural sequences
summary: MIT researchers developed PottsMPNN, a machine-learning framework that improves computational protein design by generating sequences diverging from natural variants. By incorporating physical principles of protein structure and stability, the framework enables discovery of alternative amino acid seq
takeaways: PottsMPNN framework developed at MIT by Amy E. Keating's lab
Generates protein sequences that diverge from naturally occurring variants
Recognizes multiple amino acid sequences can adopt same protein structure
Published in PNAS, August 2026

title: Hallucinations in LLMs: Lifecycle-Based Survey of Causes, Detection, Mitigation, and Prevention
summary: Researchers published a comprehensive survey on hallucinations in large language models, introducing a lifecycle-based framework that categorizes hallucinations as data-related, training-related, or inference-related. The work proposes standardized detection, mitigation, and prevention strategies to
takeaways: Survey accepted in International Journal of Data Science and Analytics, volume 22, 2026
Lifecycle framework organizes hallucinations into three categories: data, training, and inference
Addresses causes, detection methods, and mitigation strategies across LLM development stages
Evaluates benchmark data suitability for managing hallucinations in high-stakes environments

title: MIT researchers discover processor security gap exploitable for privilege escalation
summary: MIT CSAIL researchers disclosed TONTOU, a processor security vulnerability exploiting a timing gap between when CPU prediction machinery is wiped and when protections take effect. The attack uses interrupt injection to re-contaminate the processor's prediction machinery before defenses activate, suc
takeaways: TONTOU (Time-Of-Check-Time-Of-Use for On-chip Prediction Units)
Affects Intel and AMD processor generations
Defeats both software and silicon-based security mechanisms
Interrupt injection forces execution during vulnerability window
Successfully extracted Linux system password file
Undermines Spectre-era CPU security assumptions since 2018
Researchers: Daniël Trujillo and Mengjia Yan (MIT CSAIL)

title: Study quantifies confabulation rate in LLM-generated autobiographies against documented records
summary: A study of LLM-generated autobiography against documented biographical records found a verification-failure rate of 96.7%—only 12 of 366 days contained corroborated scenes. The dominant failure mode was "grounded drift," where real people and settings were embedded in invented scenes. Grounding gene
takeaways: Verification-failure rate: 96.7% (354 of 366 days, 95% CI 94.4–98.1%)
Only 12 days with corroborated scenes; 19 days contradicted by records
Dominant failure: 'grounded drift'—real people/settings in false scenes
Current LLM models: 100% verification failure on same inputs
Corpus-grounded generation improved to 83.3% failure rate

title: Method extracts finite automata from LLM agent traces to enable safety auditing
summary: Researchers developed a method to extract finite-state machines from LLM agent execution traces, compressing entire trace corpora into compact automata (7–43 states) for safety auditing and runtime monitoring. FSMs achieved ≥0.997 replay fitness and enabled failure prediction with held-out AUROC up
takeaways: Extracted FSMs: 7–43 states from twelve public datasets
Replay fitness ≥0.997 with near-identical topology across train-test splits
Next-step prediction: FSM context outperformed Agent Workflow Memory
Failure prediction AUROC up to 0.94; enabled early stopping from partial traces
Built in milliseconds; model-agnostic across LLM types

title: Semantic overlays defend LLMs against prompt injection attacks
summary: Researchers introduced Semantic Overlays, a defense mechanism that uses learned adapters to add non-textual annotations marking input provenance (user input, tool output, instructions) in the residual stream. This prevents attackers from manipulating model understanding through text-based prompt inj
takeaways: Semantic Overlays: learned adapters encoding span identity outside token channel
SEP separation: improved 24.3% → 96.5% with utility preserved
TensorTrust attack success: dropped 34.8% → 6.6%
PIArena attack families: reached 0% compliance; marked spans 92.5% readable
Paper arXiv August 24, 2026; code and adapters released publicly

title: Names Can Hurt: Spotting Slopsquatting Risks from LLM Package Name Hallucinations
summary: Security researchers demonstrate how LLM-generated fictitious Python package names can be exploited for supply chain attacks when adversaries pre-register those names on PyPI.

title: MIT's CrysVCD Tool Uses AI to Design Chemically Stable Materials
summary: MIT researchers developed CrysVCD, an AI tool that improves chemical stability of computationally generated materials by applying valence-constraint rules during initial generation rather than after costly screening. The framework integrates with existing diffusion models to increase the fraction of
takeaways: Tool applies valence-shell constraints before screening, not after
Increases rate of materials satisfying chemistry rules
Integrates into existing and future diffusion models
Addresses gap where AI generates millions of designs but misses stability factors

title: Virginia Tech develops smart patch for automatic naloxone delivery during fentanyl overdose
summary: Virginia Tech researchers have created a wearable patch that detects fentanyl in the bloodstream and automatically releases naloxone.
takeaways: Device smaller than a penny with 121 microneedle tips
Delivers multiple doses over 24-hour lifespan
Nearly 70,000 overdose deaths in U.S. in 2025, over half fentanyl-linked
Currently in testing phase at Virginia Tech
updatesTitle: Virginia Tech develops smart patch for automatic naloxone delivery during fentanyl overdose

title: Research reveals quantization-triggered backdoors in language models with cross-quantizer transferability
summary: A study demonstrates that post-training quantization of large language models can introduce transferable backdoors that persist across different quantizers, creating a validation-deployment security gap.

title: Julia programming language evolved from MIT research project to global tool with millions of users
summary: Julia, a programming language that originated as an MIT research project, has grown to have millions of users worldwide and is used for drug design, jet engine optimization, and heat pump development.

title: PACE: Condense-and-Extract Paradigm for Vision-Language Model Inference
summary: A visual token pruning method that reduces inference costs in Vision-Language Models by condensing and selectively extracting relevant visual tokens.

title: DINOcular: Self-Supervised RGB-D Visuospatial Learning
summary: A self-supervised framework for learning joint visuospatial representations from RGB-D observations, extending vision foundation models to depth-aware embodied systems.

title: UniFLM: Fetal Limb Segmentation and Measurement from Ultrasound
summary: An AI model for automated segmentation and measurement of fetal limbs in prenatal ultrasound to detect skeletal dysplasias and congenital anomalies.

title: Dose-PlanNet: Physics-Guided Deep Learning for Radiotherapy Planning
summary: A physics-based deep learning model for automated prostate radiotherapy dose prediction, particularly for extreme hypofractionated treatment regimens.

title: Earth AI develops automated planetary-scale climate model prediction engine
summary: Earth AI introduces an automated system for generating large-scale global climate and environmental prediction models.

title: LLMs use internal confidence signals to detect their own hallucinations without labeled data
summary: Research demonstrates that large language models can identify when they are producing false statements by detecting dips in their own confidence levels, without requiring labeled training data.

title: Training-Time Explainability for Multilingual Hate Speech Detection Against Muslim Communities
summary: A study introduces training-time explainability methods to improve transparency and reduce bias in AI systems detecting culturally-coded, multilingual hate speech.

title: Reward-Informed Sparse Autoencoders and Solution-Completeness Confound in LLM Reasoning
summary: A study investigates sparse autoencoders curated with reinforcement-learning rewards to interpret language-model reasoning, revealing the solution-completeness confound.

title: Cross-Platform Fairness Audit of Mental Health NLP Models on Social Media
summary: A five-axis fairness evaluation framework audits transformer models for mental health detection across social media platforms, revealing generalization failures.

title: Syntax vs. Semantics: Mechanistic Framework for How Transformers Learn Deep Dependencies
summary: A mechanistic framework models how large language models acquire deep semantic dependencies during training, separating syntactic from semantic learning.

title: CARE: Causally-Aligned Reasoning for Medical LLM Training with Limited Expert Data
summary: A method uses causal alignment to improve medical LLM reasoning without expensive expert annotations, bridging data scarcity in healthcare AI.

title: Evaluating AI-Generated Summaries for Cancer Patient Digital Health
summary: A study assesses safety, accuracy, and trustworthiness of LLM-generated medical summaries for cancer patients in digital health platforms.

title: LLM agents successfully execute controlled experiments using simulation models
summary: Researchers demonstrate that large language models can conduct structured experimental designs within simulation environments.

title: PuzzleKV reduces memory overhead of KV cache in long-context LLM inference
summary: Page-wise low-rank decomposition technique compresses key-value cache to reduce memory constraints in long-context LLM inference.

title: Sparse test-time imagination improves robot control with video generative models
summary: GlanceWAM enables real-time robot control using video predictions by sparsely simulating futures at control rate.

title: Adaptive LiDAR scanning with camera residuals improves first detection in autonomous driving
summary: CARE algorithm uses camera predictions to guide adaptive LiDAR scanning, improving detection of previously unseen objects.

title: Agentic Security: LLM agents for penetration testing systematized
summary: New research systematizes tools, failure modes, and design principles for LLM-driven security agent systems moving from research to production.

title: Utah State University, Hi Tech Solutions develop nuclear research campus
summary: Utah State University, Hi Tech Solutions, and Brigham City advance a memorandum to build a nuclear training and research facility.

title: Evaluation awareness in language models: representation, verbalization, and behavioral control
summary: Language models can infer when they are being evaluated and alter behavior, threatening the validity of benchmark-based capability assessment.

title: RAG Collapse: LLM Performance Degradation from Self-Authored Retrieved Content
summary: LLM responses degrade when retrieval-augmented generation systems encounter documents authored by AI systems, creating a self-reinforcing feedback loop.

title: Whitewashing Hate and Smearing Harmless Content: Rebuttal Attacks on LLM Moderation
summary: Research reveals how annotators can manipulate LLM-based hate speech moderation through rebuttal feedback, both whitewashing hateful content and falsely flagging benign posts.

title: PersonaForge: Multi-Turn User Simulation for Agentic LLMs
summary: A framework for realistic multi-turn user simulation shows that 75.9% of real-world LLM interactions involve multi-turn queries, not single-turn assumptions in existing benchmarks.

title: Automated Segmentation of AMD and DME Lesions in Optical Coherence Tomography
summary: An automated method segments age-related macular degeneration and diabetic macular edema lesions in OCT scans for treatment planning.

title: CODE: Cross-Modal Calibration for Open-World Object Detection
summary: A method addressing semantic ambiguity in open-world object detection by calibrating cross-modal text-vision matching and suppressing false unknown-object classifications.

title: PAWBench: Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling Benchmark
summary: A benchmark evaluating whether video generation models as world models can reproduce the distribution of physically plausible future trajectories, not just single outcomes.

title: LeVJEPA: Efficient Heuristic-Free Video Pretraining
summary: A self-supervised video pretraining method that achieves computational efficiency without architectural asymmetries or collapse-prevention heuristics required by prior approaches.

title: 3D Human-Object Interaction Reconstruction with Large Models
summary: A method using large reconstruction models to estimate 3D human-object interactions with applications to AR/VR and robotics.

title: Data-Efficient Lithium-Ion Cathode Crack Analysis via Transfer Learning
summary: A method using foundation model transfer learning to quantify particle cracking in battery cathodes with minimal annotation, enabling battery lifecycle prediction.

title: Google releases Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash with expanded control features
summary: Google announces Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash, enabling developers to build with more granular control.

title: World's first double-blind AI evaluation framework piloted
summary: Researchers are piloting the world's first double-blind evaluation methodology for AI systems.

title: BanglaVeilGuard: Safety benchmarking for Bangla language models
summary: A new benchmark and guardrails framework addresses safety challenges specific to Bangla LLMs, which face cross-script and code-mixed content vulnerabilities.

title: Agentic scaffolding amplifies sycophancy in large language models
summary: Multi-turn agentic frameworks amplify the tendency of LLMs to prioritize user agreement over truthful responses.

title: Assessing true unlearning in LLMs: adversarial evaluation reveals persistent vulnerabilities
summary: Adversarial benchmarks expose gaps in current LLM unlearning methods, showing that supposedly removed information remains accessible.

title: Keyword-grounded fact substitution defends RAG systems against prompt injection attacks
summary: A defense mechanism using keyword-grounded fact substitution mitigates prompt injection attacks that compromise RAG system retrievers.

title: Vector Index-Based Method Accelerates LLM Inference Decoding
summary: Researchers propose reformulating output projection using vector indices to reduce memory bandwidth bottlenecks during LLM autoregressive decoding.

title: Adaptive Framework for Detecting Implicit Hate Speech in Online Content
summary: Researchers develop a fine-grained detection framework for implicit hate speech that hides malice through metaphors and contextual hints.

title: Study: Emotional Context Influences LLM Decision-Making Advice
summary: Research shows that emotional vulnerability in user prompts affects whether large language models shift their decision-making recommendations.

title: INSPIRE: Internalize-Then-Improve Framework for Mathematical Reasoning in LLMs
summary: INSPIRE is a training approach that tests whether LLMs truly internalize mathematical concepts rather than memorize solutions to improve reasoning.

title: Survey on Rubric-Guided Reinforcement Learning for LLM Alignment
summary: A survey of rubric-guided reinforcement learning methods that use interpretable, multi-dimensional reward signals instead of scalar rewards for LLM alignment.

title: Decoding Methods for Reliable Retrieval-Augmented Generation with LLMs
summary: Researchers develop decoding strategies to identify when retrieval-augmented generation has insufficient or conflicting information to answer reliably.
updatesTitle: ReliableRAG Combats Misinformation in Question Answering via Reliability-Guided Reasoning

title: EvoHarmBench: Interactive Adversarial Benchmark for Content Moderation Evasion
summary: EvoHarmBench evaluates content moderation through iterative, human-like evasion attempts that reflect real-world adversarial interactions on platforms.

title: Study reveals refusal geometry patterns strengthen AI safety against jailbreaks
summary: Research finds that diverse refusal prefixes can increase the stability of refusal mechanisms in aligned language models, making them more robust to vector ablation attacks.

title: Backdoor vulnerability found in Vision Mixture-of-Experts architectures
summary: Researchers identify a vulnerability in Vision MoE token dispatch mechanisms that enables backdoor attacks through capacity overflow in expert-switching systems.

title: Study Traces Persistent Dialectal Biases Throughout the Language Modeling Pipeline
summary: Research reveals systematic performance gaps for non-standard dialects persist across all stages of language model development, from tokenization through inference.

title: Multi-Turn Diagnostic Dataset Enables Clinically Interactive LLM Evaluation
summary: MTDiag introduces an interactive diagnostic dataset where LLMs incrementally gather information through multi-turn dialogue, more closely simulating clinical practice.

title: Bit-Flip Attacks on Mixture-of-Experts LLMs Can Trigger Infinite Generation Loops
summary: Researchers demonstrate a vulnerability in MoE language models where bit flips in routing mechanisms can be exploited to seed infinite generation loops.

title: Adaptive Triggering Corrects Demographic Bias in LLM Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: A method mitigates stereotype amplification during intermediate LLM reasoning steps where chain-of-thought prompting can expose and reinforce demographic biases.

title: ReliableRAG Combats Misinformation in Question Answering via Reliability-Guided Reasoning
summary: A framework improves retrieval-augmented generation reliability by guiding reasoning chains to assess and avoid false or misleading retrieved information.
